map.滴点 190℃（≥180 ✓）、锥入度 250（∈220~295 ✓）、腐蚀 1: Dropping point 190℃ (≥180 ✓), penetration 250 (∈220~295 ✓), corrosion class 1 (≤1 ✓): all three pass → overall pass; the report can be used for quality acceptance.
map.锥入度大小代表什么？: What does cone penetration magnitude represent?
map.锥入度是润滑脂稠度指标，数值越大越软；220~295 为常用 2 号脂区间，过软: Cone penetration is a grease consistency index; larger value = softer. 220~295 is the common No. 2 grease range — too soft leaks, too hard is hard to pump; must match equipment.
map.滴点低于 180℃ 有什么风险？: What is the risk if dropping point is below 180℃?
map.滴点是润滑脂开始流失的温度，低于 180℃ 在高温轴承/齿轮上易软化流失失去润滑: Dropping point is the temperature at which grease begins to flow; below 180℃ it softens and drains on high-temp bearings/gears, losing lubrication and increasing wear or even overheating.
map.滴点反映润滑脂耐热性，滴点偏低高温会流失: Dropping point reflects heat resistance; low value means loss at high temperature
map.锥入度反映稠度，值越大越软: Cone penetration reflects consistency; larger value = softer
